The '''Bothan sky dragon''' were a rare and almost extinct species of reptilian avians. [[Mithel/Legends|"Mauler" Mithel]] used to hone his combat skills by shooting them out of the sky with his father's [[T-16 skyhopper/Legends|T-16 skyhopper]].<ref name="JKTCG">{{JKTCG|set=Premiere|cardname=DS-61-2 • "Mauler Mithel"|link=http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/cardlists/premier/large/51Cds612maulermithel.html}}</ref>
